checks.name: restore
argv:
set -eu
phase="$1"; target="$2"; tests="$3"; runner="$4"; locked="$5"
sdk=10.0.401; runtime=10.0.12; tfm=net10.0
fail() { echo "dotnet-web: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$target" != __REQUIRED_TARGET__ ] && [ "$tests" != __REQUIRED_TEST_PROJECT__ ] || fail 'set explicit build and test targets in repository recipe overrides'
for path in "$target" "$tests"; do
 case "$path" in ''|/*|../*|*/../*|*/..|-*|*\*) fail 'targets must be repository-relative paths';; esac
 [ -f "$path" ] || fail "missing target: $path"
done
case "$target" in *.sln|*.slnx|*.csproj) ;; *) fail 'build target must be a solution or C# project';; esac
case "$tests" in *.csproj) ;; *) fail 'test target must be an explicit C# test project';; esac
case "$runner" in VSTest|Microsoft.Testing.Platform) ;; *) fail 'unsupported test runner';; esac
case "$locked" in true|false) ;; *) fail 'declare locked restore as true or false';; esac
actual=$(dotnet --version) || fail 'prepare SDK; inspect global.json; host installation is forbidden'
[ "$actual" = "$sdk" ] || fail "selected SDK $actual differs from $sdk; inspect global.json"
runtimes=$(dotnet --list-runtimes) || fail 'cannot inspect runtimes'
case "$runtimes" in *"Microsoft.NETCore.App $runtime "*) ;; *) fail "prepare .NET runtime $runtime";; esac
case "$runtimes" in *"Microsoft.AspNetCore.App $runtime "*) ;; *) fail "prepare ASP.NET Core runtime $runtime";; esac
# Property evaluation respects imported repository props and SDK selection. It does not restore.
case "$phase" in restore)
 if [ "$locked" = true ]; then
  dotnet restore "$target" --locked-mode
  exec dotnet restore "$tests" --locked-mode
 fi
 dotnet restore "$target"
 exec dotnet restore "$tests";;
 build)
 dotnet build "$target" --configuration Release --framework "$tfm" --no-restore -p:RunAnalyzersDuringBuild=true
 exec dotnet build "$tests" --configuration Release --framework "$tfm" --no-restore -p:RunAnalyzersDuringBuild=true;;
 format)
 dotnet format "$target" --verify-no-changes --no-restore
 exec dotnet format "$tests" --verify-no-changes --no-restore;;
 test)
 is_test=$(dotnet msbuild "$tests" -getProperty:IsTestProject -nologo) || fail 'cannot evaluate test project'
 [ "$is_test" = true ] || fail 'required test project is not marked IsTestProject; inspect test SDK and restore state'
 mtp=$(dotnet msbuild "$tests" -getProperty:IsTestingPlatformApplication -nologo) || fail 'cannot evaluate test platform'
 if [ "$runner" = Microsoft.Testing.Platform ]; then
  [ "$mtp" = true ] || fail 'selected MTP runner requires an MTP test application and matching global.json test.runner'
  exec dotnet test --project "$tests" --configuration Release --framework "$tfm" --no-build --minimum-expected-tests 1
 fi
 [ "$mtp" != true ] || fail 'MTP application cannot use the VSTest recipe; match global.json test.runner'
 exec dotnet test "$tests" --configuration Release --framework "$tfm" --no-build -- RunConfiguration.TreatNoTestsAsError=true;;
 *) fail 'unsupported recipe phase';;
esac
